answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable 5-credit bond before bidding. A Sybil operator opening 1,000 accounts must immobilize 5,000 credits; if duplicate claims are proven, the affected bonds are slashed, making mass identities expensive rather than free. Apply the same rule in every market pool, whether named ledge, hollow, or tundra, so relabeling accounts cannot bypass the cost.
